description: This file defines enums, structs, and constants related to Watch Commands and Notifications for the OpenClaw project, including message types, payloads, risk levels, actions, and status representations.

methods.name: OpenClawWatchAction.init
methods.description: Initializes an OpenClawWatchAction with specified id, label, and optional style.

methods.name: OpenClawWatchStatusPayload.init
methods.description: Initializes a status payload with support, pairing, installation, reachability, and activation state details.

methods.name: OpenClawWatchNotifyParams.init
methods.description: Initializes notification parameters including title, body, priority, prompts, session, kind, details, expiry, risk, and actions.

methods.name: OpenClawWatchNotifyPayload.init
methods.description: Initializes notification payload with delivery timing and transport method.
